using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Oracle.ManagedDataAccess.Client;
var cfg=new ConfigurationBuilder().AddJsonFile("/srv/ossmmasoft-pruebas/shared/config/vertical.json",false,false).Build();var checks=new List<string>();
void Check(bool v,string n){if(!v)throw new InvalidOperationException(n);checks.Add(n);}
List<string> Blocks(string path){var result=new List<string>();var block=new StringBuilder();foreach(var line in File.ReadLines(path)){if(line.TrimStart().StartsWith("--"))continue;if(line.Trim()=="/"){if(block.ToString().Trim().Length>0)result.Add(block.ToString().Trim());block.Clear();}else block.AppendLine(line);}Check(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(block.ToString()),"script-complete");return result;}
string Normalize(string text)=>string.Join("\n",text.Replace("\r","").Split('\n').Select(l=>l.TrimEnd())).Trim();
string Comparable(string value)
{
 var clean=string.Join("\n",value.Replace("\r","").Split('\n').Where(l=>!l.TrimStart().StartsWith("--")&&l.Trim()!="/").Select(l=>l.TrimEnd())).Trim();
 clean=Regex.Replace(clean,@"\ACREATE\s+OR\s+REPLACE\s+","",RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
 clean=Regex.Replace(clean,@"\APROCEDURE\s+(?:RH\.)?","PROCEDURE ",RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
 return string.Join("|",Regex.Matches(clean,@"'(?:''|[^'])*'|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$#]*|[0-9]+|[^\s]").Select(m=>m.Value.StartsWith("'")?m.Value:m.Value.ToUpperInvariant()));
}
try{
 using var cn=new OracleConnection(cfg["ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnectionRH"]);await cn.OpenAsync();OracleCommand Cmd(string sql){var c=cn.CreateCommand();c.BindByName=true;c.CommandTimeout=25;c.CommandText=sql;return c;}
 using(var c=Cmd("SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME'),SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVER_HOST'),SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER') FROM DUAL"))using(var r=await c.ExecuteReaderAsync()){await r.ReadAsync();Check(cfg.GetValue<int>("settings:EmpresaConfig")==13&&r.GetString(0)==cfg["OracleAnalysis:Targets:RH:ExpectedDatabaseName"]&&r.GetString(1)==cfg["OracleAnalysis:Targets:RH:ExpectedServerHost"]&&r.GetString(2)=="RH","qa-identity");}
 var expected=Blocks(args[0]);Check(expected.Count==1,"single-feature-procedure");
 var current=new StringBuilder();using(var c=Cmd("SELECT TEXT FROM USER_SOURCE WHERE NAME='SP_RH_NOM_BASE_PER' AND TYPE='PROCEDURE' ORDER BY LINE"))using(var r=await c.ExecuteReaderAsync())while(await r.ReadAsync())current.Append(r.GetString(0));
 var prior=Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(""));
 Check(Comparable(current.ToString())==Comparable(prior)||Comparable(current.ToString())==Comparable(expected[0]),"existing-source-matches-reviewed-version");
 if(Comparable(current.ToString())!=Comparable(expected[0])){using var c=Cmd(expected[0]);await c.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();}
 using(var c=Cmd("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_ERRORS WHERE NAME='SP_RH_NOM_BASE_PER'"))Check(Convert.ToInt32(await c.ExecuteScalarAsync())==0,"no-procedure-errors");
 using(var c=Cmd("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME='SP_RH_NOM_BASE_PER' AND OBJECT_TYPE='PROCEDURE' AND STATUS='VALID'"))Check(Convert.ToInt32(await c.ExecuteScalarAsync())==1,"feature-procedure-valid");
 Console.WriteLine("R57_BASE_PER_GUARD="+JsonSerializer.Serialize(new{Status="OK",Checks=checks,NoPayrollWrites=true,LegacyPackageChanged=false}));
}catch(OracleException ex){Console.WriteLine("R57_FAIL_ORACLE="+ex.Number);Environment.ExitCode=1;}catch(InvalidOperationException ex){Console.WriteLine("R57_FAIL_CHECK="+ex.Message);Environment.ExitCode=1;}
